text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — I uploaded the company-level OKR draft for next quarter here: https://docs.internal/redwood/okrs/q2-draft :link: Need final approvals by EOD Friday so we can lock roadmap + comms.
Maya: High-level goals included: 1) Improve hosted text gen p50 latency by 20% 2) Reduce per-token hosted cost 15% via batching/quantization 3) Dedicated GA (reserved capacity) launch to 3 customers 4) Enterprise bookings $3.5M ARR. Details + success criteria in the doc.
Sanjay: Thanks — skimmed. Concern on latency target: our telemetry shows p50 already depends a lot on tail sequence length. Do we mean model-level latency or service p50? Need to be explicit in success criteria.
Priya: Re: Dedicated GA — engineering estimates 10-week sprint to get autoscaling and SLOs stable. Stretch target to hit 3 customers is fine, but GA date might slip if we block on certs/audits.
Maya: Good call. I'll update objective language to say "service p50" and add rollout gating criteria (SLOs + compliance checklist). Priya, can you paste a minimal gating checklist we can link?
Priya: Sure. Rough: 1) End-to-end deploy test (qps+latency) 2) Canary rollback within 5m 3) KMS integration validated 4) Audit logs present. I can turn that into a short PR.
Ben: From GTM — the $3.5M target depends on closing two pilot deals with Dedicated and one multi-year Hosted enterprise. We should mark one of those as "customer-sourced" so sales can prioritize.
Luca: For the latency & quality objective, we should add a safety net: quality regressions <1% on eval prompts compared to baseline. Otherwise batching/quant changes might regress outputs.
Maya: Adding that as an explicit KR: "No >1% regression on core eval set (generation fidelity)." Good catch, Luca.
Rina: Finance: can we split the bookings number into ARR vs. renewal assumptions? Also, if Dedicated GA slips, revenue might shift Q. Suggest we include confidence bands in the OKR doc (high/med/low forecast).
Alex: Quick note from exec perspective — I want the doc to show dependencies and critical path (Infra, Security, Sales). Also need a single owner per objective for sign-off. Maya, please add owners and a risk column.
Maya: Will do. Proposed owners: Latency KR — Priya, Cost KR — Sanjay, Dedicated GA — Priya, Revenue — Ben. Is everyone OK?
Priya: OK from Eng.
Sanjay: OK for Cost and happy to co-own batching rollout with Priya.
Ben: OK.
Luca: Fine with the quality KR owner being Research — I'll add it to the doc.
Rina: Finance will review final numbers Thurs AM. If you want me to run sensitivity analysis, ping me.
Maya: Thanks. Two small negotiation asks: (a) Can we relax latency from 20% to 15% if it unlocks cost savings faster? (b) Can we make Dedicated GA target "3 customers (with at least 1 paid)" instead of 3 paid? Would make target more realistic if audits slow things.
Sanjay: I'm +1 on 15% if we define the engineering tradeoffs expected. We should quantify CPU/GPU slot savings per 1% latency improvement.
Priya: Agree on adjust. For Dedicated, count paid=1 seems reasonable as long as Sales commits pilots and timelines.
Ben: Sales can commit to 2 strong pilots and 1 conversion target. We should keep the stretch to 3 paid but accept baseline as 3 customers with at least 1 paid.
Alex: Sounds pragmatic. Update doc with baseline vs stretch and owners. After that I'll do a final pass and sign off.
Maya: I'll update now: change latency to 15% baseline, 20% stretch; Dedicated baseline = 3 customers (>=1 paid), stretch = 3 paid; add owners, gating checklist, and risk/confidence columns. I will also add the quality KR from Luca and Rina's sensitivity note.
okrs-bot: Reminder — deadline for final OKR changes: Friday 23:59 PST. No edits after lock.
Maya: Quick check — all thumbs? :eyes:
Sanjay: :thumbsup:
Priya: :thumbsup:
Ben: :thumbsup:
Luca: :thumbsup:
Rina: :thumbsup:
Alex: :thumbsup: I'll sign after the doc reflects baseline/stretch and owners.
Maya: Thanks all — I will push the doc update and ping when ready for final sign-off."
